Initialization command data adapted from 78/xiaozhi-esp32@49b4380b3faa0ceadd28a3e78aaf0f311c46c57e, main/boards/quandong-s3-dev/quandong_s3_dev_board.cc. Repository MIT copyright and terms retained in LICENSE. Retains all19 valid command payloads/order. Omits three malformed cmd0 entries declaring17/17/41bytes from1byte backing arrays; does not guess their intended opcodes. Sleep exit is supplied by the pinned ILI9341-2.1.0driver and display-on by the common API. Local static length check prevents payload overread. No upstream board class or application code copied.
